notes: §1985:VI.5.9.3 SR5: "The PICTURE clause must be specified for every elementary item except an index data item or the subject of the RENAMES clause. In these cases the use of this clause is prohibited." The requirement is CheckPictureRequiredPass.Run: every entry IsPictureLessLeaf still finds after usage inheritance (no PICTURE, no subordinates, not level 66 or 88) is refused with COBOL0881; an index data item is not one, because the usage pass gives it its profile. The 1985 edition differs from 2023 in the VALUE-implied PICTURE, and SynthesizeImpliedPicture gates it (value-implied-picture-2002, COBOL0900 at --std 85), so 01 A VALUE "ABC". is refused. The two prohibitions: Sr8PicturelessVerdict refuses a PICTURE on a USAGE INDEX item (COBOL0881), written on the item or inherited from its group, and the grammar's dataDescriptionBody makes renamesClause an alternative to the clause list, so a PICTURE beside RENAMES is a syntax error (COBOL0001 after, COBOL1941 before). Probed at 85: 01 WS-A., 77 A., a level 05 without PICTURE, USAGE COMP, BINARY, PACKED-DECIMAL and DISPLAY without PICTURE all refused COBOL0881; USAGE INDEX without PICTURE accepted, on an item and under a USAGE INDEX group; PIC 9(4) USAGE INDEX refused both ways; 66 R RENAMES B THRU C accepted, with PIC XX refused; the later editions' picture-less usages (POINTER, BINARY-LONG) refused COBOL0900. USAGE COMP-1 and COMP-2 compile without a PICTURE at 85: they are the implementor's documented extension (COBOL2894 under --flag-extensions), not a 1985 usage. The witness is 01 WS-A. with no clause.

next.reason: 1985 requires PICTURE for every elementary item except an index data item or a RENAMES subject, and prohibits it for those two. §2023:13.16.3 SR8 keeps both prohibitions and the requirement 'except as indicated in Syntax rule 9'. §2023:13.16.3 SR9 lets PICTURE be omitted when the VALUE clause gives a nonempty alphanumeric, boolean or national literal, with PICTURE X(length) implied. An elementary item with VALUE 'ABC' and no PICTURE, refused in 1985, is accepted. SR8's extra prohibited usages exist only in 2023.
